solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Quotes that limit what people say

definitions.meaning: quote marks, the punctuation around a citation
the marks enclose spoken words, fencing off exactly what was said

explanation.surface: A remark about quotations being restrictive on free speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech marks are commonly called quotes, and they bracket the start and end of reported speech.

clue.text: A US Senate review causes disgust

indicators.note: a review looks the material over again, so these letters are reworked into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An American Senate inquiry provokes public revulsion.
explanation.definitionFit: To nauseate someone is to sicken them, which is what something revolting does.

clue.text: Makes equal sides with the French eliminated

indicators.note: eliminated means knocked out, so the piece for the French is removed from the sides

parts.note: football or cricket teams are elevens, each fielding eleven players
le is the French masculine word for the

explanation.surface: Levelling the teams after the French side is knocked out of the tournament.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking LE out of ELEVENS leaves the answer; 'sides' as teams is a standard crossword sense.
explanation.definitionFit: To even things is to level them, bringing two amounts into balance.

clue.text: Dog whistles seen at back of car

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them closely, to tail them
pipes are simple whistles, small wind instruments

explanation.surface: Dog whistles being noticed at the rear of a vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Exhaust pipes stick out of the rear of cars, so they are what one notices behind a vehicle.

clue.text: A capital city possibly held one

indicators.note: possibly signals that the word held could be arranged otherwise

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A capital city might have been occupied by one force.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian capital region New Delhi lies within the city, a national seat of government.

clue.text: How item might be made too late

definitions.meaning: the word item can be formed by rearranging the letters of time, i.e. made out of that word

explanation.definitionFit: Missing the deadline means the allotted period has run out; and item is literally made from rearranged letters of time.

clue.text: Indicates an unpopular test

definitions.meaning: the ... test, a disliked British check on income before granting benefits

explanation.definitionFit: To mean something is to signify it; the means test is a resented assessment of household income.

clue.text: Fine associated with 7 suggests modest income

definitions.meaning: placed before the answer to 7, it forms a phrase for a small income

explanation.definitionFit: Slim and delicate things are fine; slender means are a limited income.

clue.text: Kick start

definitions.meaning: the backward jolt of a gun when fired
to flinch or jump back in shock

explanation.definitionFit: A firearm's kick is its backward jolt, and to start in fright is to jerk back.

clue.text: Escape final Japanese offensive, we're told

indicators.note: we're told points to what is heard, a word sounding like the pieces

parts.note: the final letter of Japanese is E, and offensive means lewd, together sounding like the answer

explanation.surface: Fleeing the last Japanese attack, according to reports.
explanation.walkthrough: E, the last letter of 'Japanese', plus LEWD is said like the answer; 'offensive' looks like a military push but means crude.
explanation.definitionFit: To elude pursuers is to escape or evade them.

clue.text: Uncomfortable being sick — relax!

parts.note: ill means unwell
at ease is the military order to relax

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell and being told to calm down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At ease!' is the drill command letting soldiers stand relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling ill at ease is an idiom for being awkward and uncomfortable.

clue.text: Frank takes to drink and talks freely

parts.note: frank means candid or open
to sup is to sip or drink

explanation.surface: A man called Frank turns to the bottle and becomes chatty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frank' looks like a man's name but means candid.
explanation.definitionFit: To open up is an idiom for confiding and speaking freely.

clue.text: Find out about employment, as the tea maker did

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the scrambled letters wrap the other piece
out means disordered, so the letters of find are rearranged

parts.note: use means employment, as in putting something to use

explanation.surface: A job seeker researching work, with a tea maker aside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the anagram signal on 'Find', and 'about' wraps the result round the word for employment; the definition is a whimsical past-tense description of brewing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone brewing tea steeps the leaves in hot water, which is past-tense infusing.

clue.text: Flat terrace needed for coffee production

indicators.note: the letters needed are found running through the words flat terrace

explanation.surface: A level patio required for growing coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: A milky espresso drink is a coffee concoction served in cafés.

clue.text: Prospective test concerning voters

parts.note: elect after a title means chosen but not yet in office, as in president-elect
an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A prospective exam relating to voters.
explanation.definitionFit: Electoral matters relate to the electorate, the body of people who vote.

clue.text: Man with many titles damned by a duke

definitions.meaning: someone who issues lots of books
the Duke of Wellington told a blackmailer to publish and be damned

explanation.definitionFit: A firm or person that issues many books has many titles; Wellington's retort is famous.

clue.text: Saint lets in tailless dog to sleep on this?

indicators.note: lets in means admits, so one piece is put inside another

parts.note: Saint Bede, the Venerable Bede, an English monk and historian

indicators.note: tailless means losing the last letter

parts.note: a setter is a gun dog breed

explanation.surface: A saint lets a dog without its tail in to sleep on a sofa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tailless' docks the dog's last letter and 'lets in' puts it inside the saint; Bede was an eighth-century English monk.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa that converts into a bed is something one could sleep on.

clue.text: A prediction of dreadful things we're told to manage

indicators.note: we're told points to what is heard, a word sounding like the pieces

parts.note: horrors are frightful things
to cope is to manage

explanation.surface: Forecasting awful events that we are advised to handle.
explanation.walkthrough: HORRORS said aloud is close to HOROS; then add COPE.
explanation.definitionFit: An astrological forecast is a prediction of what lies ahead.

clue.text: Owned property that's haunted

explanation.definitionFit: To have possessed something is to have owned it; a haunted house is said to be possessed.

clue.text: Had a good time and left, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly signals a word as heard, not as written

parts.note: parted means left or went away

explanation.surface: Someone enjoyed themselves and then departed, so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: To have partied is to have celebrated and enjoyed oneself.

clue.text: Fireside's not hot where we live

indicators.note: not here means without, so the letter for hot is removed

parts.note: the hearth is the floor of the fireplace
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps

explanation.surface: The hearth isn't warm in our home.
explanation.definitionFit: Our planet is where humanity lives.

clue.text: He admits Wally left to cause trouble

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so the word he takes the other pieces inside

parts.note: taken as written
wally is British slang for a fool, as is ass

explanation.surface: A man confesses that Wally left to make trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: WALLY is British slang for a silly person, so it gives ASS.
explanation.definitionFit: To hassle is to pester or bother someone.

clue.text: Do nothing with jerky movement, unlike such dancers

parts.note: to do someone can mean to rob or swindle them
O is zero, nothing
a tic is an involuntary twitch

explanation.surface: Moving jerkily, quite unlike graceful dancers.
explanation.definitionFit: Mechanical, stiff movement is the opposite of fluid dancers.

clue.text: South African boycott starts to turn ugly

parts.note: a ban is a boycott

indicators.note: starts to picks the opening letters of turn and ugly

explanation.surface: A South African boycott begins to sour.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bantu are a large group of peoples of southern Africa.

clue.text: Disheartened pack chase bird call into valley

indicators.note: chase means follow, so this piece comes after the bird call

parts.note: a coo is the call of a dove or pigeon

indicators.note: disheartened means losing the middle letter

parts.note: a mob is a pack or crowd

explanation.surface: A dispirited pack of hounds hunts a bird call down into a valley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disheartened' removes the middle letter of the pack, and 'chase' places it after the bird call; a coomb is an English word for a valley.
explanation.definitionFit: A coomb is a short valley or hollow on a hillside, especially in southern England.

clue.text: Passes English with mistakes

parts.note: lapses are slips or errors

explanation.surface: Someone passes an English exam despite errors.
explanation.definitionFit: Time that elapses passes or goes by.

clue.text: Helpful officers die as ordered!

indicators.note: ordered means arranged, so the letters of die as are rearranged

explanation.surface: Officers obediently die as commanded.
explanation.definitionFit: Aides-de-camp are officers who assist a commander.

clue.text: Deepest swimming monster gets in first

indicators.note: first means coming before, so this word leads
swimming means moving about, so the letters of monster are jumbled

explanation.surface: A monster in the deep water gets in ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swimming' is the anagram signal on 'monster', and 'first' puts 'in' ahead of the result; 'gets' merely links.
explanation.definitionFit: The innermost part is furthest inside, the deepest.

clue.text: Dogs may when master returns bearing duck

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so the reversed piece holds the other
returns means the word for master is read backwards

parts.note: a lord is a master
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, O

explanation.surface: Dogs drool when their owner comes back carrying a duck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns LORD to DROL, and 'bearing' puts O inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogs often salivate when they see food.

clue.text: Style of blazers debaters exchange after a match

indicators.note: after places this piece behind the other

parts.note: a double is an exact match

indicators.note: exchange means swap round, so the letters of debaters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Debaters swapping places after a contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A double-breasted blazer has overlapping front panels with two rows of buttons.
